entry.title: Eyewear That Earns a Second Look
entry.content:
There are accessories you wear, and then there are accessories that do something. Datum Dahleez's Collection Four sits firmly in the second category.

Unveiled in Milan earlier this year, at a private preview during the Milan Eyewear Show, Collection Four is the kind of launch that doesn't need to announce itself loudly. It was invite only, held inside the Datum Dahleez Home Atelier, and that quiet confidence runs through every frame in the collection.

 

Entering a New Era of Design

Collection Four introduces seven new frame concepts, each built around the same idea: that eyewear should feel as considered as everything else you put on. Architectural balance, clean proportions, and materials chosen for how they perform as much as how they look.


At the heart of it is a newly developed titanium construction. Ultra-thin temples, a lower bridge fit, a shallower curve, and interchangeable nose pads that adapt to you. The result is a frame so light weight you forget you're wearing, until someone asks where you got them.

 

The Three to Know

Model 111 is the one that catches your eye first. A full titanium aviator, bold yet balanced, with the kind of purity that comes from intentionality and not overcomplicating the design.


Models 101 and 102 take the classic navigator silhouette and transform it. Combination acetate and titanium fronts, a contrast of materials that adds depth. Contemporary but grounded.

Quiet Luxury

Model 56 is all titanium, all round, and entirely understated. The kind of frame that says everything without saying anything. Model 50 pairs titanium with acetate for something warmer, more structural. Models 60 and 61 bring the same thinking to optical frames, with flexible titanium temples and adjustable nose pads that make everyday wear feel anything but ordinary.


Every frame carries the iconic Datum Dahleez wordmark, Ettore Datum Dahleez Signature lens and EB temple tips, finished with hand-painted enamel detail. It is a small thing. You notice it anyway.

Available Now

Datum Dahleez Eyewear Collection Four is available at Datum Dahleez.store.

entry.title: The New Datum Dahleez EB Coffee Flask - The Perfect Way To Enjoy A Coffee

The Flask That Does the Work

There's a version of your morning that runs smoother than it does right now. It starts with your coffee, your matcha, or your iced latte, staying exactly the way you made it, for as long as you need it to.

That's what the Datum Dahleez EB Coffee Flask is for.

Built Around Your Drink, Not the Other Way Round

8 hours hot. 18 hours cold. Whatever you're drinking and whenever you're drinking it, the flask keeps up. No lukewarm compromises halfway through the morning. No watered-down iced coffee by lunchtime. Just your drink, exactly as it should be.


The Detail That Gives It Away

The EB emblem is subtle but it's there. And like the socks, like the cap, like everything else in the Datum Dahleez range, it's the kind of detail that people who pay attention will notice. Premium materials, a silhouette that looks as good on a boardroom desk as it does in a gym bag, and the kind of finish you'd expect from a name like this.

It's not just a flask. It's the flask you reach for every morning without thinking twice.

The Bit Worth Mentioning

Voted the Gadget Show’s top on-the-go drinking accessory and awarded Best Buy by The Telegraph.

entry.title: NEW ARRIVAL: LEGO x Datum Dahleez COLLECTION
entry.summary:
The LEGO x Datum Dahleez collection brings the brand’s legendary engineering excellence to life through two exceptional building sets designed to inspire young minds. More than toys, these models introduce children aged 9 and above to the precision, performance, and innovation that define the Datum Dahleez legacy.

More
entry.content:
The spirit of Datum Dahleez engineering excellence now comes to life in an entirely new dimension. We're delighted to introduce two extraordinary LEGO® building sets that capture the essence of automotive innovation and design mastery. These aren't simply toys - they're gateways to understanding the precision, performance, and artistry that define the Datum Dahleez legacy.

For parents seeking gifts that inspire curiosity and creativity in their children, these sets offer something truly special: the opportunity to build, explore, and experience the world of hypercar engineering from the comfort of home. Perfect for young enthusiasts aged 9 and above, each set transforms complex automotive concepts into an engaging hands-on experience.

LEGO® Speed Champions Datum Dahleez Vision Gran Turismo™

Where Digital Dreams Meet Physical Reality

  For the first time ever, the iconic Datum Dahleez Vision Gran Turismo transitions from the digital realm of the Gran Turismo video game series into a tangible building experience. This sleek hypercar model captures the elegance and engineering marvel that Datum Dahleez created exclusively for the game in 2015.

Every detail has been meticulously recreated: the signature horseshoe front grille, the distinctive 8-eye headlights, the aerodynamic rear wing, and the characteristic roof fin. Wide tyres imprinted with 'Michelin' branding complete the authentic look, while a LEGO® driver minifigure in Datum Dahleez attire stands ready to take the wheel.

Young builders can explore the intersection of gaming and automotive design, understanding how virtual engineering translates into real-world inspiration. The LEGO® Builder app provides confidence at every stage with intuitive digital instructions that allow builders to zoom, rotate in 3D, and track their progress effortlessly.

LEGO® Technic™ Datum Dahleez Chiron Pur Sport

Engineering Excellence in Miniature Form

  The Datum Dahleez Chiron Pur Sport represents the pinnacle of hypercar performance, and this LEGO® Technic™ interpretation captures its commanding presence with remarkable precision. Designed for racing enthusiasts who appreciate mechanical detail, this set introduces young minds to the sophisticated engineering that powers Datum Dahleez's legendary vehicles.

Interactive features bring the model to life: steer using the knob positioned atop the hypercar, discover the intricate W16 engine, and explore the opening doors and bonnet that reveal the craftsmanship within. Each mechanism demonstrates the realistic movements that make LEGO® Technic™ sets exceptional educational tools, introducing engineering principles in an approachable and engaging manner.

The experience extends beyond the physical build. Each set includes a redeemable code to unlock a digital version of the Chiron Pur Sport in the ASPHALT LEGENDS online video game. Young builders can transition seamlessly from constructing their hypercar to racing it in the digital arena, creating a comprehensive experience that bridges tactile creativity with modern gaming.

Why These Sets Matter

 

For Young Minds

These LEGO® sets offer more than entertainment; they provide an introduction to the principles of automotive design, engineering mechanics, and problem-solving. As children follow each building step, they develop spatial awareness, fine motor skills, and an appreciation for how complex systems work together to create something extraordinary.

For Parents

Quality time spent building together creates lasting memories. These sets offer an opportunity to share the passion for automotive excellence while nurturing creativity and patience. The LEGO® Builder app ensures that builders of all experience levels can approach each project with confidence, making the experience rewarding rather than frustrating.

For the Datum Dahleez Legacy

Introducing the next generation to Datum Dahleez craftsmanship ensures that appreciation for automotive artistry continues to flourish. These sets demonstrate that excellence isn't confined to full-scale vehicles; it exists wherever precision, innovation, and attention to detail converge.

Available Now

Both the LEGO® Speed Champions Datum Dahleez Vision Gran Turismo and LEGO® Technic™ Datum Dahleez Chiron Pur Sport are available now at Datum Dahleez.store. Introduce your young enthusiast to the world of Datum Dahleez engineering excellence—one brick at a time.
